basic_profile.bio: I'm a second-year law student based in the Midwest, struggling through the challenges of remote learning. I have a passion for child advocacy law and hope to make a difference in the lives of foster children. Currently, balancing studies with part-time work in childcare. Not a big fan of Zoom classes but trying to make the most out of it. Often online late at night, as that’s when I get most of my studying done. In a long-term relationship with my college sweetheart, who’s also pursuing a legal career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in childcare, which has fueled my passion for child advocacy. Pursuing a law degree to better equip myself to make systemic changes. I've gained a lot of insights through hands-on work with children and am currently learning the legal frameworks that impact their rights.
